title: Create from a candidate
summary: deployment-runs create and start-for-item bind the same source: without one, the gate branch tip, reusing that commit's own CI proof from any branch and dispatching only when it has none; an explicit commit needs its own proof. Recoveries name each command's own source flag and never suggest an older green commit that may omit a member. start-for-item first returns the run to the same environment already holding the item, or another project's in-flight release to it whose bound source contains its merge (reused); a live bound release without the merge refuses as bound_release_in_flight, naming the run and its pinned commit. Merge close-out at the release wait names the start-for-item command.
